notes.title: Get Anodyne 2 + Analgesic's Games On Sale!!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33021367/40f4ce2bb264048fefdd2f9e1d42a98c5c70cb0d.png[/img]
Hey all, Melos from Analgesic here. Thanks for helping us make this year's Summer Sale our strongest yet! But there's still some time left in the sale - so if you haven't, go pick up our games today! (And be sure to leave a review, especially for Anodyne 2!)

- Explore a dream world in Anodyne 1..  (-65%)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/234900/Anodyne/

- In a low-poly 3D world, shrink into people's minds in Anodyne 2... (-65%)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/877810/Anodyne_2_Return_to_Dust/

- Explore a surreal, immersive island's cavern in Sephonie.. (-60%)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1248840?

- Travel a grand world and learn of its citizens as you jump through dangerous power plants in Even the Ocean... (-80%)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/265470/Even_the_Ocean/

Or play the demo of our upcoming game, Angeline Era... and bump the world!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393920/Angeline_Era/

notes.title: Sephonie coming to Consoles on July 21st!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33021367/614ea89de8db3246c1b882cd0849e8c45c0a2dd3.jpg[/img]

I'm happy to announce that Sephonie, our 2022 3D Platformer, is coming to all consoles on July 21st! You can wishlist or pre-order here:

- [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/sephonie-switch/]Switch[/url]
- [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10008002]Playstation[/url]
- [url=https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/sephonie/9nxthjwttpx1]Xbox[/url]

Thanks for your support as we work on our next game, Angeline Era, a 3D Action game! (Which you can wishlist below)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393920

- Melos

notes.title: Save big on Analgesic's unique adventures in the Steam Summer Sale!
notes.content:
Looking for another exciting adventure by us to play? All of our games are currently on sale! Take a look below...

In [b]Sephonie[/b], cave dive into a mysterious and spiritual island!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33021367/40f4ce2bb264048fefdd2f9e1d42a98c5c70cb0d.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1248840

In hybrid 2D-3D [b]Anodyne 2[/b], dive into the infected's minds to cure them of the Nano Dust...

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33021367/07773d29a9f17b78926ad52eae1512f362ab427f.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/877810/Anodyne_2_Return_to_Dust/

Or if you're not looking to buy, why not wishlist our upcoming 3D Action RPG, Angeline Era?

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33021367/e326f9b1002e0746396a5e1970cfe4e3c65b7815.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393920

---

There's even more games!

See where we got started in the indie classic, Anodyne, a dream-world, dark and surreal 2D Zelda-lite:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/234900/Anodyne/

Utilize nature to change your physics and jump through a hand-illustrated world of power plants and ecological disaster in Even the Ocean:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/265470/Even_the_Ocean/

Dive into a father's "Memory World" in the FREE 3D Adventure-Novel, All Our Asias!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/698050/All_Our_Asias/

All sales go directly towards keeping us completely independent! 

- Melos Han-Tani (co-director)
